critical_code_review_comments: FinancePage.jsx line 60 references ReviewQueuePanel — ESLint reports react/jsx-no-undef. The build compiled because CRA only emits a warning for undefined JSX components at build time; the error only surfaces at runtime when the page renders. Recommend enabling `no-undef` as an error in CI.

FinancePage.jsx is 1124 lines. Once ReviewQueuePanel is added it will grow further. Consider extracting each *Panel component to its own file under /pages/finance/panels/ — the file is well past the 700-line guideline.

The ErrorBoundary catches the crash but there's no defensive fallback for the tab content; a broken tab component brings down the whole page (all sibling tabs become unreachable). Consider per-tab ErrorBoundaries so one bad panel doesn't blow up siblings.

Backend receipts.py: /review-queue query filters {needs_review: True, reversed: {$ne: True}} but does NOT filter to status='draft'. If an approved-then-later-flipped JE ever had needs_review re-set, it would surface here. Consider adding `status: 'draft'` to the filter for defensive robustness.

reports.py fx logic silently ignores fx_target when fx_rate is missing (and vice-versa). Consider raising 400 if exactly one of the pair is provided — currently a caller who supplies only fx_target gets a report in the base currency with no warning.

rca of the issue: Main agent's iter 293 diff on FinancePage.jsx added the <TabsTrigger value='review' data-testid='finance-tab-review'> in the TabsList AND the <TabsContent value='review'><ReviewQueuePanel /></TabsContent> below it, and changed TabsList to grid-cols-5 max-w-3xl — but the actual `function ReviewQueuePanel(){...}` body was never included in the committed file. Grepping the file for 'ReviewQueuePanel' returns ONLY the single reference on line 60. ESLint flags this as react/jsx-no-undef. At runtime React tries to render an undefined identifier, throws ReferenceError, and the app-level ErrorBoundary catches it — replacing the entire Finance page with the 'Something went wrong' fallback. Fix: add the ReviewQueuePanel component (either inline in FinancePage.jsx or as a new file that's imported at the top of FinancePage.jsx).
